data.summary: This week Ethan Qiu recorded 31 GitHub contribution counts and 24 pushes across public repositories, led by UTMIST/Misty with 23 commits and 13 pushes. He also contributed to qiuethan/Portfolio with 5 commits and 6 pushes, and to qiuethan/now with 3 commits and 5 pushes. He opened pull requests in UTMIST/Misty (#263, #265, #267, #269), qiuethan/Portfolio (#1–#6), and qiuethan/now (#1–#3), and reviewed pull requests in UTMIST/Misty (#230, #247, #259, #260, #261, #262, #264, #268).
